paragraphs.text: Lucky and Zorba (; "The Little Seagull and the Cat") is a 1998 Italian animated drama film directed by Enzo D'Alò, based on The Story of a Seagull and the Cat Who Taught Her to Fly () by Luis Sepúlveda. The film was dubbed in English by Trimark Pictures in 1999 and aired on Toon Disney during the early-to-mid 2000s.
